question: Clutch time means the last 5 minutes of the 4th quarter or any overtime, when the score is within 5 points. Among players with at least 150 clutch field goal attempts from 2015-16 to 2022-23 (regular season and playoffs), who has the highest clutch effective field goal percentage, and how many attempts did they take?
answer:
Between 2015-16 and 2022-23, Rudy Gobert had the highest clutch effective field goal percentage (eFG%) at 68.8% on 189 attempts. Clutch time is defined as the 4th quarter or overtime, with 5:00 or less left and the score within 5 points of the opponent.

| Player | Clutch FGA | Clutch eFG% | Non-Clutch eFG% | eFG% Change | Avg Dist (ft) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Rudy Gobert | 189 | 68.8% | 66.0% | +2.8% | 2.5 |
| Bam Adebayo | 165 | 60.0% | 54.7% | +5.3% | 7.3 |
| Andre Drummond | 179 | 58.9% | 53.4% | +5.6% | 4.4 |
| Kelly Oubre Jr. | 200 | 58.3% | 50.3% | +7.9% | 14.0 |
| Joe Harris | 161 | 58.1% | 60.5% | -2.5% | 14.0 |
| Domantas Sabonis | 169 | 56.8% | 57.0% | -0.2% | 6.7 |
| Aaron Gordon | 177 | 56.8% | 52.2% | +4.6% | 12.5 |
| Terry Rozier | 284 | 55.1% | 49.9% | +5.2% | 17.3 |
| JJ Redick | 189 | 54.2% | 56.5% | -2.2% | 22.0 |
| Jae Crowder | 180 | 54.2% | 52.0% | +2.2% | 19.3 |

- **Shot selection**: Top players like Gobert and Drummond maintain high efficiency by taking 95.2% and 74.3% of their clutch attempts at the rim (dunks, layups, or tip-ins).
- **League-wide baseline**: League-wide clutch eFG% is 48.6% (on 60,456 FGA), which is lower than the non-clutch average of 52.7% (on 1,557,220 FGA).
- **Small sample noise**: Kelly Oubre Jr. has the highest change (+7.9%), but with 200 attempts, the standard error is ~3.5%. This gap is within noise limits and may be a product of selection bias.

args.query:
WITH player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fga,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fgm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fgm,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fg3m ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fg3m,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fga,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fgm ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fgm,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fg3m ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fg3m
  FROM player_shooting
  GROUP BY player_id, player_name
)
SELECT player_name,
       clutch_fga,
       ROUND(100.0 * (clutch_fgm + 0.5 * clutch_fg3m) / clutch_fga, 1) AS clutch_efg,
       non_clutch_fga,
       ROUND(100.0 * (non_clutch_fgm + 0.5 * non_clutch_fg3m) / non_clutch_fga, 1) AS non_clutch_efg,
       ROUND(100.0 * (clutch_fgm + 0.5 * clutch_fg3m) / clutch_fga - 100.0 * (non_clutch_fgm + 0.5 * non_clutch_fg3m) / non_clutch_fga, 1) AS efg_change
FROM player_stats
WHERE clutch_fga >= 150
ORDER BY clutch_efg DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fga,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fgm ELSE 0 END) + 0.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fg3m ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END), 1) AS clutch_efg,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fga,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fgm ELSE 0 END) + 0.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fg3m ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END), 1) AS non_clutch_efg
FROM player_shooting;

args.query:
SELECT player_name,
       COUNT(*) AS clutch_shots,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN shot_kind IN ('dunk', 'layup', 'tip_in') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS rim_shot_share,
       ROUND(AVG(shot_distance_ft), 1) AS avg_dist_ft
FROM clutch_plays
WHERE player_name IN ('Rudy Gobert', 'Bam Adebayo', 'Andre Drummond', 'Kelly Oubre Jr.', 'Joe Harris')
  AND event_type IN ('MADE_SHOT', 'MISSED_SHOT')
GROUP BY player_name
ORDER BY rim_shot_share DESC;

WITH player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fga,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fgm ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fgm,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_clutch THEN fg3m ELSE 0 END) AS clutch_fg3m,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fga ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fga,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fgm ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fgm,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_clutch THEN fg3m ELSE 0 END) AS non_clutch_fg3m
  FROM player_shooting
  GROUP BY player_id, player_name
),
top_players AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name, clutch_fga,
         ROUND(100.0 * (clutch_fgm + 0.5 * clutch_fg3m) / clutch_fga, 1) AS clutch_efg,
         ROUND(100.0 * (non_clutch_fgm + 0.5 * non_clutch_fg3m) / non_clutch_fga, 1) AS non_clutch_efg,
         ROUND(100.0 * (clutch_fgm + 0.5 * clutch_fg3m) / clutch_fga - 100.0 * (non_clutch_fgm + 0.5 * non_clutch_fg3m) / non_clutch_fga, 1) AS efg_change
  FROM player_stats
  WHERE clutch_fga >= 150
  ORDER BY clutch_efg DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT t.player_name, t.clutch_fga, t.clutch_efg, t.non_clutch_efg, t.efg_change,
       ROUND(AVG(p.shot_distance_ft), 1) AS avg_dist_ft,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.shot_kind IN ('dunk', 'layup', 'tip_in') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS rim_share
FROM top_players t
JOIN clutch_plays p ON t.player_id = p.player_id AND p.event_type IN ('MADE_SHOT', 'MISSED_SHOT')
GROUP BY t.player_name, t.clutch_fga, t.clutch_efg, t.non_clutch_efg, t.efg_change
ORDER BY t.clutch_efg DESC;
